name: こども園の条例の参照条文を変更
summary: 現在、条例第17条は児童福祉法第33条の10第1項各号を参照しています。この議案では参照先を法第27条の2第1項各号に改め、公布の日から施行します。
changes: 第17条の参照先を児童福祉法第33条の10第1項各号から法第27条の2第1項各号に改める
why: 幼保連携型認定こども園の運営基準の改正に伴い、条例の規定を整えるためと、区は説明しています。

en.name: Updates a statutory reference for certified early childhood education and care centers
en.official: Ordinance Partially Amending the Setagaya City Ordinance on Standards for Class Organization, Staff, Facilities, and Operations of Certified Centers for Early Childhood Education and Care
en.summary: Article 17 of the ordinance currently refers to each item of Article 33-10, Paragraph 1 of the Child Welfare Act. This bill changes the reference to each item of Article 27-2, Paragraph 1 of the Act and takes effect on the date of promulgation.
changes: Changes Article 17's reference from each item of Article 33-10, Paragraph 1 of the Child Welfare Act to each item of Article 27-2, Paragraph 1 of the Act
en.why: The ward says this is to align the ordinance's provisions with amendments to the operating standards for certified centers for early childhood education and care.
